items.raw_excerpt: Experts say people considering freezing their eggs for non-medical reasons need more evidence-based information as most will not use them and, even if they do, the procedure is not a guaranteed pathway to parenthood.

items.raw_excerpt: A bariatric surgeon says about half of his initial consults with patients now do not proceed to surgery - and a more stringent KiwiSaver approach may be to blame.
items.summary_en: A bariatric surgeon in New Zealand says about half of his first meetings with patients no longer lead to surgery. He thinks tougher KiwiSaver withdrawal rules may be the reason. The rules may make it harder for people to pay for the operation.
